Would You Rather Game

60 Would You Rather dilemmas — pick a side, see how your choice stacks up against other players, and keep score of the rounds.

📖 How to use

  1. Read the dilemma.
  2. Tap the option you would rather do.
  3. See the vote split for that question.
  4. Hit “Next” for another of the 60 dilemmas.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How many questions are included?

60 dilemmas built in, from silly to deep — no repeats until you've seen them all.

Where do the vote percentages come from?

Vote percentages are stored in your browser and update every time you (or anyone on this device) votes.

Can I play with friends?

Your picks are tallied per session so you can compare with friends.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes — fully mobile friendly.
